summary: Duke Energy Progress, LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1.0 billion offering of first mortgage bonds in two series: $700 million of 5.55% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036 and $300 million of 6.15% First Mortgage Bonds due 2056. Price to public was 99.650% and 99.904%, respectively, with proceeds before expenses of $693.0 million and $297.1 million. Interest pays semi-annually each March 15 and September 15 from March 15, 2027; settlement is expected on or about September 11, 2026. The bonds are secured by a continuing first mortgage lien, rank equally with existing first mortgage bonds, are redeemable at the company's option, and carry a special 101% Tax Credit Event redemption. This is a routine investment-grade utility debt takedown under an effective shelf, not a special situation.
